title: Use represented coordinate distances in nonuniform Hessian stencils
observation: For the affine function x-2**40, a requested step 1.25*2**-13 produces unequal representable distances and the old Hessian is 5242.88 instead of zero.
cause: The denominator used requested eps squared, assuming exactly symmetric representable perturbations.
severity: incorrect arithmetic, state or evidence admission on valid/ambiguous boundary inputs
implemented_change: Use actual positive/negative displacements, nonuniform second derivatives, and tensor-product first-derivative weights for mixed partials. Cache axis evaluations and preserve the 2*n*n+1 objective-call budget.
predicted_consequence: New constructed regressions fail on the recorded parent and pass after the repair while the existing bounded suite passes.
